messages.subject: outputting pngs from qplot charts
parts:
Could anyone explain what "x" refers to in 

qplot(k,geom=c("histogram"), data=pp6)
png("plot.png") 
plot(x)
dev.off()

( this is taken from Quick-R example on outputting data), but "x" is never referenced above.

when i use it in my example:

qplot(k,geom=c("histogram"), data=pp6)
png("plot.png") 
plot(x)
dev.off()

it gives me:

> plot(x)
Error in plot(x) : 
  error in evaluating the argument 'x' in selecting a method for function 'plot'

the plot is produced, but it's empty, has but a white square in it. what am i doing wrong?
